Directory Purpose Contents
wiki/etfs/ Per-ETF pages 21 pages: position state, trend, backtest trade history table, decision links
wiki/decisions/ Trade decisions Per-signal pages: rule cited, inputs (price/EMA/capital), outcome, Claude narrative
wiki/daily/ EOD summaries Daily scan results: headline numbers, signal list, market notes

wiki/log.md Event timeline Grep-able log: INGEST, SCAN, SIGNAL, FILL, BACKTEST events

Strategy Rules (from PRD)

Rule Condition Action
ENTRY STRONG trend (close > EMA21 > EMA60) + pullback detected Buy tranche 1: ₹3,00,000 at close
ADDON Price ≤ LBP × 0.975 (2.5% drop) + within addon window Buy next tranche (₹2L / 1.5L / 1L...)
EXIT (Profit) Close ≥ WAC × 1.05 (5% profit) Sell entire position
EXIT (Time) Held ≥ 4 months without profit exit Sell entire position
ALLOCATION Max position ₹12,50,000 · Max 9 tranches Schedule: 3L / 2L / 1.5L / 1L×6
